title: Descent of a comparison between two existing neighbourhood models
statement: Let S be a Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and c:C\to S a qcqs morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let U,W\subseteq S be open, s\in W, and let P and R be finite etale covers of C_U=c^{-1}(U) and C_W=c^{-1}(W) respectively [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Put L=C\times_S Spec O_{S,s}, with projection j:L\to C [def-pc-fibre-product], and suppose l:L\to C_W satisfies l\circ i_W=j (composition read as l followed by i_W). Suppose the pullbacks of P and l^*R are isomorphic over C_U\times_C L. Then there exists an open V with s\in V\subseteq W such that P and R|_{C_V} have isomorphic restrictions to C_U\cap C_V. Here R|_{C_V} is the actual pullback of R along the inclusion C_V\to C_W; no new cover is constructed.

proof.text: Restrict the affine neighbourhood system of s to neighbourhoods V contained in W. Noetherianity makes U retrocompact. Thus U intersect V is qcqs; its base change by the qcqs morphism c is qcqs. The affine transitions base change to affine transitions, and the limit is C_U times_C L. The equation l followed by the inclusion equals j identifies the restriction of R to this limit with the iterated pullback in the hypothesis.

The fixed models restrict to finite etale, hence finitely presented covers on the overlap stages. Apply the morphism part of finite-presentation descent to the comparison and its inverse. At a common later stage the equality part descends the two equations that their composites are identities. The descended maps therefore give an isomorphism. This argument also applies when the local overlap is empty.

Pullback pasting identifies the second overlap cover with the restriction to C_U intersect C_V of R pulled back along C.homOfLE (c.preimage_mono hVW). The first is P pulled back along the left inclusion. Return V, its containment in W and membership of s, and the resulting isomorphism.

theorem FiniteEtale.exists_neighbourhood_comparison_of_stalk {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation c]
    (U W : S.Opens) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale) (s : S) (hsW : s ∈ W)
    (R : (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (l : Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme)
    (hl : l ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))
    (e : Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback
      (pullback.fst (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)))).obj PA ≅
      (FiniteEtale.pullback
      (pullback.snd (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)))).obj
        ((FiniteEtale.pullback l).obj R))) :
    ∃ (V : S.Opens) (hVW : V ≤ W), s ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback
        (C.homOfLE (inf_le_left : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≤ c ⁻¹ᵁ U))).obj PA ≅
        (FiniteEtale.pullback
        (C.homOfLE (inf_le_right : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≤ c ⁻¹ᵁ V))).obj
          ((FiniteEtale.pullback (C.homOfLE (c.preimage_mono hVW))).obj R))
